rows.ja: 提携(インテグレーター・企業)
競合(ServiceNowの年次報告に記載)

relations.text: AI Control TowerをMicrosoft Agent 365の仕組みに広げ、ServiceNowのAI機能をMicrosoftのマーケットプレイスで提供
relations.text_en: Extended AI Control Tower governance across the Microsoft Agent 365 ecosystem and made its AI specialists available through the Microsoft marketplace

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and Microsoft extended AI Control Tower governance across the Microsoft Agent 365 ecosystem

relations.text: ServiceNowが年次報告で、競合する企業向けソフト大手の1社としてMicrosoftを挙げている
relations.text_en: ServiceNow’s FY2025 10-K names Microsoft among the enterprise application software vendors it competes with

source.label: ServiceNow 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: such as Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, Salesforce and Workday

relations.text: AIエージェントの統制で提携を深め、AI Control TowerをNVIDIA Enterprise AI Factory検証済み設計に統合
relations.text_en: Deepened the partnership on agentic AI governance and integrated AI Control Tower into the NVIDIA Enterprise AI Factory Validated Design

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and NVIDIA deepened their partnership to extend agentic AI governance from desktops to data centers

relations.text: AWS Marketplaceでの取引額が10億ドルを超え、AWSとの協業を深めた
relations.text_en: Surpassed $1B in AWS Marketplace transactions and deepened its collaboration with AWS

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow surpassed $1 billion in AWS Marketplace transactions and deepened its collaboration with AWS
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com.

relations.text: AI・クラウドの相互運用に向け関係を拡大した技術提供企業の1社としてAWSを挙げている
relations.text_en: Lists AWS among technology providers with which it has expanded relationships for AI and cloud interoperability

source.label: ServiceNow 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: relationships with AWS, Google, Microsoft, and NVIDIA
source.note: AWSはAmazonの事業部門です。同じ文にGoogle・Microsoft・NVIDIAも挙げられています。
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com; the same sentence also names Google, Microsoft and NVIDIA.

relations.text: Google Cloudと5Gネットワーク・小売・IT運用向けのAIソリューションを発表。Google CloudはServiceNowを2026年のパートナー・オブ・ザ・イヤーに選出
relations.text_en: Unveiled AI solutions with Google Cloud spanning 5G networks, retail and IT operations; Google Cloud named ServiceNow a 2026 Partner of the Year

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第1四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and Google Cloud unveiled a suite of AI solutions spanning 5G networks, retail, and IT operations
source.note: Google CloudはAlphabetの事業部門です。
source.note_en: Google Cloud is a unit of Alphabet.

relations.text: AI・クラウドの相互運用に向け関係を拡大した技術提供企業の1社としてGoogleを挙げている
relations.text_en: Lists Google among technology providers with which it has expanded relationships for AI and cloud interoperability

source.label: ServiceNow 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: relationships with AWS, Google, Microsoft, and NVIDIA
source.note: 同じ文にAWS・Microsoft・NVIDIAも挙げられています。
source.note_en: The same sentence also names AWS, Microsoft and NVIDIA.

relations.text: AnthropicのClaudeモデルをServiceNowのAIプラットフォームにより深く組み込む提携の拡大を発表
relations.text_en: Announced an expanded partnership with Anthropic to integrate Claude models more deeply into the ServiceNow AI Platform

source.label: ServiceNow 2025年第4四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and Anthropic announced an expanded partnership to integrate Claude models more deeply into the ServiceNow AI Platform

relations.text: OpenAIと、企業向けのAIエージェント体験を広げる新たな協業を発表
relations.text_en: Unveiled a new collaboration with OpenAI to drive agentic AI experiences across enterprises

source.label: ServiceNow 2025年第4四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow unveiled a new collaboration with OpenAI in Q1 to drive agentic AI experiences across enterprises

relations.text: 提携を深め、Cisco AI DefenseをServiceNowのAI Control Towerに統合
relations.text_en: Deepened the partnership, including integrating Cisco AI Defense into ServiceNow AI Control Tower

source.label: ServiceNow 2025年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and Cisco deepened their partnership, including the integration of Cisco's AI Defense into ServiceNow's AI Control Tower

relations.text: LeidosがServiceNow AIプラットフォームを導入し、AIによる自律的なワークフローを展開
relations.text_en: Leidos is deploying the ServiceNow AI Platform for autonomous AI-driven workflows

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: Leidos, a Fortune 500 ® national security technology leader, is deploying the ServiceNow AI Platform

relations.text: FiservがFinancial Services OperationsとITSM向けのNow Assistの利用を拡大
relations.text_en: Fiserv will scale its use of ServiceNow Now Assist for Financial Services Operations and ITSM

source.label: ServiceNow 2025年第4四半期の決算発表
source.quote: Fiserv will scale its use of ServiceNow Now Assist for Financial Services Operations (FSO) and Information Technology Service Management (ITSM)

relations.text: Bell(カナダ最大手の通信会社)が通信向けServiceNow AIエージェントを導入
relations.text_en: Bell, Canada’s leading telecommunications provider, deployed ServiceNow AI Agents in Telecom

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第1四半期の決算発表
source.quote: Bell, Canada's leading telecommunications provider, reported a 25% improvement in customer response time
source.note: 相手は「Bell」と書かれており、BCE傘下のBell Canadaと対応づけています。
source.note_en: The counterparty is named “Bell”, mapped to Bell Canada, a BCE subsidiary.

relations.text: FerrariのOne Digital PortalはServiceNow上に構築され、FerrariはServiceNowのパートナー
relations.text_en: Ferrari’s One Digital Portal is built on ServiceNow; Ferrari is a ServiceNow partner

source.label: ServiceNow 2025年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: Ferrari’s One Digital Portal, built on ServiceNow

relations.text: Panasonic Avionicsとの提携を拡大し、同社がServiceNowのAI型CRMを導入
relations.text_en: Expanded the partnership with Panasonic Avionics, which will deploy ServiceNow AI-driven CRM

source.label: ServiceNow 2025年第4四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and Panasonic Avionics Corporation expanded their partnership to power in-flight engagement
source.note: Panasonic Holdings傘下のPanasonic Avionicsとの関係です。
source.note_en: The relationship is with Panasonic Avionics, a unit of Panasonic Holdings.

relations.text: NTT DOCOMO、StarHubと、ServiceNowのCRMによるキャリア間の自律型ローミング解決モデルを発表
relations.text_en: ServiceNow, NTT DOCOMO and StarHub introduced an inter-carrier autonomous roaming resolution model using ServiceNow CRM

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第1四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow, NTT DOCOMO, and StarHub introduced the industry's first inter-carrier autonomous roaming resolution model using ServiceNow CRM

relations.text: Accentureと、レガシーなセキュリティ基盤からの移行を支援する共同サービスを開始
relations.text_en: Launched a joint offering with Accenture to help enterprises migrate off legacy cybersecurity platforms

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and Accenture launched a joint offering to help enterprises migrate off legacy cybersecurity platforms

relations.text: ServiceNowが年次報告で、自社ソリューションを顧客に提供するグローバルなシステム・インテグレーターとしてAccentureを挙げている
relations.text_en: ServiceNow cites Accenture as a global system integrator that offers ServiceNow solutions to its customers

source.label: ServiceNow 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: global system integrators such as Accenture, Cognizant, Deloitte, EY, Infosys and KPMG

relations.text_en: ServiceNow cites Infosys as a global system integrator that offers ServiceNow solutions to its customers

source.label: ServiceNow 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: global system integrators such as Accenture, Cognizant, Deloitte, EY, Infosys and KPMG

relations.text: Experianと世界規模の戦略的提携を拡大し、Experian AscendプラットフォームをServiceNow AIプラットフォームと統合
relations.text_en: Expanding the global strategic partnership with Experian, integrating the Experian Ascend Platform with the ServiceNow AI Platform

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and Experian are expanding their global strategic partnership

relations.text: TeamViewerと、同社のエンドポイント機能をServiceNow AIプラットフォームに統合する提携
relations.text_en: Partnering with TeamViewer to integrate TeamViewer endpoint capabilities with the ServiceNow AI Platform

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and TeamViewer are partnering to integrate TeamViewer

relations.text: FedExと協業を拡大し、FedEx Dataworksの物流インテリジェンスをServiceNowのワークフローに組み込む
relations.text_en: Expanded the collaboration with FedEx to embed FedEx Dataworks logistics intelligence into ServiceNow workflows

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and FedEx expanded their collaboration to embed FedEx Dataworks logistics intelligence directly into ServiceNow workflows

relations.text: Lenovoと、技術のライフサイクル全体のワークフローを自動化する複数年の戦略的関係を発表
relations.text_en: Announced a multi-year strategic relationship with Lenovo to automate workflows across the technology lifecycle

source.label: ServiceNow 2026年第2四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and Lenovo announced a multi-year strategic relationship to automate workflows across the technology lifecycle

relations.text: Figmaのデザイン基盤とServiceNow AIプラットフォームをつなぐ共同ソリューションを開始
relations.text_en: Launched a solution with Figma connecting the Figma design platform with the ServiceNow AI Platform

source.label: ServiceNow 2025年第4四半期の決算発表
source.quote: ServiceNow and Figma launched a solution in Q4 that connects the Figma design platform with the ServiceNow AI Platform

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が、ServiceNowの2026年4月の回転与信契約の管理代理人を務める
relations.text_en: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. is administrative agent under ServiceNow’s April 2026 revolving credit agreement

source.label: ServiceNow 8-K(2026年4月1日)
source.quote: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent
source.note: 融資関係(貸し手・代理人)です。
